Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You turn through the surrounding blades, strike each opening in a single flowing sequence and step out before the circle closes.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
Up to three distinct adjacent enemies.
Duration
Damage and movement resolve immediately.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a melee weapon; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Choose the targets and roll Agility once using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among them.

Weak
Deal 4 physical damage to each.
Standard
Deal 4 physical damage to each; you may move up to 1 square without provoking afterward.
Strong
Deal 6 physical damage to each; you may move up to 2 squares without provoking afterward.

This is one signature attack, not three free attacks. All targets are chosen before any movement.

Additional rulings
